What a Transformer is, in one sentence

notebook teaches it two examples: "the dog sat on the floor" should become "dog resting", and "the cat is sleeping on the sofa" should become "the cat is sleeping peacefully". The six pictures follow one sentence through the machine, in the order it happens.

text.tspan: A token is a piece of a word. The
of them: common words are one token,
rarer ones are spelled from several ("sofa" is "sof" + "a_"; the _ marks the end of a word). Each
token has a number, its id — from here on the model sees only these numbers.

text.tspan: To write each word, the model looks back at every input word and decides how much each one
matters; the shares always add up to
. Writing "dog", this trained model leans on "floor" and
"on". It learned from only two sentences, so it memorised them: its attention need not look sensible.
Models trained on millions of sentences learn much clearer patterns.

svg.text: the encoder and the decoder · cell 2
input: the tokens of “the cat is sleeping on the sofa”
ENCODER LAYER 1 — look around (attention), then think (feed-forward)
ENCODER LAYER 2 — the same two moves again
DECODER LAYER 1 — look at its own words so far, look at the input, think
DECODER LAYER 2 — the same three moves again
